sum: LXP Industrial Trust is a publicly traded real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on Class A warehouse and distribution investments in 12 target markets across the Sunbelt and lower Midwest. LXP seeks to expand its warehouse and distribution portfolio through acquisitions, build-to-suit transactions, sale-leaseback transactions, development projects and other transactions. LXP Industrial Trust was incorporated in 1993 and is based in West Palm Beach, United States.
ceo: Mr. T. Wilson Eglin (Chairman, President & CEO)
